say:1:1331063001:1.text: Back then, the princess was always wandering outside.
say:1:1331063001:1.source_cn: 不不不，以前的公主可不喜欢呆在宫殿里，她总是溜出宫殿四...
say:1:1331063001:1.male: Back then, the princess was always wandering outside.
say:1:1331063001:1.female: Back then, the princess was always wandering outside.

say:2:1331063002:1.text: But I haven't seen her much over the past few years. She is said to be quite gravely ill.
say:2:1331063002:1.source_cn: 但这几年我没怎么见过她，据说公主是生病了，挺严重的那种。
say:2:1331063002:1.male: But I haven't seen her much over the past few years. She is said to be quite gravely ill.
say:2:1331063002:1.female: But I haven't seen her much over the past few years. She is said to be quite gravely ill.

say:3:1331063003:1.text: Anyway, the princess seems to be in good spirits today. Maybe she has recovered.
say:3:1331063003:1.source_cn: 不过今天她看来脸色不错，应该是恢复健康了。
say:3:1331063003:1.male: Anyway, the princess seems to be in good spirits today. Maybe she has recovered.
say:3:1331063003:1.female: Anyway, the princess seems to be in good spirits today. Maybe she has recovered.
